newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB says competition pressures profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB says competition pressures profit.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Thursday competition in all markets would be unrelenting and would place increasing pressure on the ability of the group to sustain its record profits.

"Another challenge facing the National and banks in general is clear divergence between the reality of the qualiy of the products provided and the perception of government, consumer groups and the like," said managing director Don Argus in a statement accompanying the half year results.
NAB, Australia's largest bank, reported a 14.1 percent rise in net profit to A$1.14 billion in the six months ended March 31, 1997.
